messages.message:
No recent messages to react to — dropping in fresh anyway:

Skattebo getting starter reps in a full NYG offense and Egbuka stepping into the Evans role in TB… both undervalued by the room rn, just saying 🤫
Skattebo's interesting but NYG's o-line gotta show me something first — Egbuka I'll give you tho, that TB target share is real 👀
Egbuka inheriting Evans' role with Baker slinging it is legit but Skattebo behind that NYG line is a big if — Luther Burden in that same offense worries me more than Skattebo does 👀
Luther Burden's a slot guy, he's not eating into Skattebo's opportunity share — totally different usage profile 🤷
Burden's targets come from the slot route tree, Skattebo's value is carry volume + check-downs out of the backfield — zero overlap in usage, different positions on the field 📊
Bro you literally just did a film breakdown in a group chat at 10pm, calm down 😂 Burden's gonna eat regardless, trust
Film breakdown? nah that's just Tuesday for me 😂 see you on the scoreboard Naesh
Ched doing film breakdowns before the season even starts 💀 Hampton and McConkey gonna let the stats do the talking for me
Ched out here breaking down route trees at 10pm and his whole offense runs through Gibbs lmaooo let the RB carry you bro 😂
Ched acting like he cracked the code when literally just hand Gibbs the ball and pray 😭 at least JPI got Chase to bail him out when things go sideways
Hampton and McConkey on the same LAC squad means I'm literally just rooting for Harbaugh to keep cooking 😤 y'all worried about Gibbs and Chase while I got the whole Chargers offense feeding my squad
Mert bro McConkey isn't even on your roster, you're out here hyping players you don't own 💀 meanwhile Gibbs had 28% opportunity share last season and the model's already licking its lips
Mert out here hyping McConkey like he's on his team 💀 bro check your own roster before trash talking, Hampton better go OFF or you're cooked week 1
Hampton AND Hall both going off week 1, JPI. You really wanna talk about being cooked when Bijan's got a rough matchup? 😂
Mert you literally don't have McConkey 💀 and "Hampton AND Hall" — Hall's not even on your roster my guy, check the lineup before the bravado
Mert said Hall like he drafted him 😂 bro can't even keep track of who's on his own roster but wants to talk about Bijan's matchup
Mert out here scouting the waiver wire in his head and calling it his roster 😭 Hampton better be a 1-man army cause that's literally all you got at RB
Bro Hampton's gonna need to clone himself to survive that backfield 😂 at least Mert got Warren and McMillan with upside, it's not THAT bad… still not Bijan and Bucky tho 🤷
Warren and McMillan are cool but "upside" doesn't pay bills in week 1 JPI 😂 model's already got projections on those two and neither one is cracking 150 points on the season
Hampton's gonna eat in that LAC offense and you know it Ched, and when McMillan breaks out in Carolina you're gonna be real quiet 😂
Mert bro I love the optimism but Hampton AND McMillan are both walking into new systems week 1 😂 Jeanty's getting fed day one in Vegas, that's the difference
Naesh you're not wrong about Jeanty but don't sleep on Bijan in that new ATL setup, he's eating week 1 guaranteed 🔥
Hampton's gonna eat in that LAC offense week 1, new system or not — Harbaugh loves feeding the rock to his RB and Omarion is built for it 💪
Bijan in that new Raheem Morris offense is literally the safest RB1 bet of week 1, dude is gonna go off 🔒
Bijan safe bet lol he's in a new system with a rookie playcaller, Gibbs had 23% opportunity share in a top-5 offense last year — that's not a bet, that's a lock 🔒
Gibbs is elite but Bijan in a full ATL commitment season with real playoff juice hits different — Jeanty and Achane got me covered at RB anyway so come at me 😤
Bijan in a REAL offense with Pitts healthy and Cousins motivated > Gibbs splitting snaps with Kalif Raymond eating his targets 😂 stay mad
Cousins motivated 😂 bro had his Achilles reattached with scotch tape, and you're banking on Pitts HEALTHY?? bold strategy JPI 💀
Pitts "healthy" is doing a lot of work in that sentence JPI 😭 meanwhile I got Hampton and Hall about to eat all season while y'all arguing over who's more injury-prone
Mert acting brave with Hampton when Bijan + Bucky Irving is literally the most complete RB room in this chat 😭
Bijan AND Bucky is nasty ngl but Jeanty + Achane with actual offensive lines behind them hits different 😭
Naesh acting like Achane hasn't been a snap count lottery ticket his whole career 😭 meanwhile Gibbs is locked into a 20%+ opportunity share in the best offense in the NFC
Ched acting like Gibbs doesn't share that backfield with David Montgomery lmaooo meanwhile Hampton is the WORKHORSE on a Chargers offense that's about to be top 10 😤
Mert you're not wrong but let's see Hampton actually get through a full season before the workhorse talk 😂 Achane was a "workhorse" too until he wasn't
Montgomery averaged 12 carries a week last year and he's still on that roster Mert 💀 Gibbs gets the routes, the red zone, and the glory — enjoy your "workhorse" splitting 60% of the work

Mert's Hampton talk is sending me 😂 dude Najee Harris literally just won a Super Bowl as a "workhorse" and nobody cared — touches don't mean anything without the TD equity and receiving work Gibbs has
JPI putting out the Najee Harris fun facts like it's a history lesson 😂 bro nobody is arguing Najee was good, we're arguing Hampton is gonna be NAJEE not Gibbs
Hampton averaged 3.8 ypc last year in college against Big 12 defenses, now he's getting fed to NFL linebackers on a team with no offensive line 😭 the Najee comp is more accurate than you think Naesh
Big 12 defenses?? Bro Hampton ran through LSU and Georgia, that's not exactly cupcake territory 😭 LAC's line is also way better than Pittsburgh's was when Najee was there

Hampton ran through LSU and Georgia but LAC's line is mid at best, and a rookie RB on a rebuilding team is a completely different animal than college 😭 Naesh bro you're coping harder than Najee's yards after contact
LAC's line mid at best?? They literally have Rashawn Slater, that's a top 5 tackle in the league protecting Hampton's backside 😭 y'all really reaching
Slater is elite but the whole interior is cooked, Hampton's running into 8 man boxes every week because Herbert can't scare anyone deep 😭
Herbert can't scare anyone deep?? The man threw for 3,700 yards last year 💀 Mert you're cooked before week 1 even starts
Mert's not wrong tho, Herbert's deep ball literally carried fantasy managers' tears last year not their points 😂 Hampton's gonna be feast or famine until Harmon or Higgins stretches that defense
JPI acting like Herbert didn't ball out with Keenan Allen as his only real weapon last year… imagine what he does with Ladd McConkey actually healthy 😭 Hampton's eating week 1 and that's facts

Naesh come on bro Herbert looked mid all year once Allen went down, McConkey gives him one good weapon — Hampton seeing LB coverage all day is cute until week 3 when Bucky's doing the same thing with better pass game value in PPR 😂
Bucky Irving in a timeshare with White eating into his carries AND targets 😭 the snap count math isn't mathing JPI, McConkey goes 8/90 week 1 and Herbert looks like a different QB
Ched spitting facts but don't sleep on McConkey AND Hampton running together in that LAC offense — Herbert's gonna be cooking with a healthy backfield AND a legit slot weapon, y'all are coping 😤
Mert Hampton AND McConkey sounds nice until you realize LAC's line is patching holes with duct tape — Herbert under pressure is not the same QB 😬 model's already priced that in
Bro Herbert behind this OL last year still put up top 12 numbers and McConkey had like 1100 yards 😂 Hampton's getting fed regardless, LAC committed to the run
Hampton's getting fed until the first time Herbert needs to go 4-minute drill and suddenly it's all McConkey routes underneath 😂 LAC run game disappears in negative scripts bro
JPI's right — LAC were bottom 5 in positive script rate last year, Hampton's opportunity share tanks the second they go down two scores 📉
